Title: 정책에 따른 시스템 로깅 설정
Description: 계정 관리(실패), 계정 로그온/권한 사용/로그온/정책 변경(성공 및 실패), 디렉터리 서비스(실패) 감사 설정
CheckCommand: $temp = "$env:TEMP\sec_audit_chk.inf"; if (Test-Path $temp) { Remove-Item $temp -Force }; secedit /export /cfg $temp /quiet; if (Test-Path $temp) { $content = Get-Content $temp; $ok = $true; $policies = @{ 'AuditAccountManage' = '2'; 'AuditAccountLogon' = '3'; 'AuditPrivilegeUse' = '3'; 'AuditDSAccess' = '2'; 'AuditLogonEvents' = '3'; 'AuditPolicyChange' = '3' }; foreach ($k in $policies.Keys) { $line = $content | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*$k\s*=\s*(.*)$" } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($line -and $Matches) { if ($Matches[1].Trim() -ne $policies[$k]) { $ok = $false } } else { $ok = $false } }; Remove-Item $temp -Force; $ok.ToString() } else { 'False' }
RemediationCommand: $temp = "$env:TEMP\sec_audit_rem.inf"; if (Test-Path $temp) { Remove-Item $temp -Force }; secedit /export /cfg $temp /quiet; if (Test-Path $temp) { $content = Get-Content $temp -Raw; $policies = @{ 'AuditAccountManage' = '2'; 'AuditAccountLogon' = '3'; 'AuditPrivilegeUse' = '3'; 'AuditDSAccess' = '2'; 'AuditLogonEvents' = '3'; 'AuditPolicyChange' = '3' }; foreach ($k in $policies.Keys) { if ($content -match "(?m)^\s*$k\s*=") { $content = $content -replace "(?m)^\s*$k\s*=.*", "$k = $($policies[$k])" } else { if ($content -match '\[Event Audit\]') { $content = $content -replace '\[Event Audit\]', "[Event Audit]`r`n$k = $($policies[$k])" } } }; $content | Set-Content $temp; secedit /configure /db "$env:TEMP\sec_audit.sdb" /cfg $temp /quiet; Remove-Item $temp -Force }
